name: Rapid Shot
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Rapid Shot (Combat)
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 132
You can make an additional ranged attack.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit: When making a full-attack action with a ranged weapon, you can fire one additional time this round at your highest bonus. All of your attack rolls take a –2 penalty when using Rapid Shot.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 130
When using this feat, you can spend a number of stamina points up to the number of shots taken using this feat. If you do, you decrease the penalty of a single Rapid Shot ranged attack by 2 for each stamina point you spent.
Mythic Rapid Shot
Source Mythic Adventures pg. 72
You can fire many times each round with amazing precision.

Prerequisites: Rapid Shot.

Benefit: When using Rapid Shot, you can either ignore the feat’s –2 penalty on attack rolls or make two additional attacks instead of one.
